Staff Accompanist — Edmond Ballet Academy

Edmond Ballet Academy is hiring a staff accompanist for our ballet and
modern dance classes, five afternoons a week during the school year.
You'll be improvising live to class combinations, so strong
sight-reading and the ability to vamp on the spot matter more than
repertoire memorized in advance.

Bachelor's degree in Music or equivalent professional experience is
required — we care much more about hearing you play a class than
seeing a transcript. $35/hour, W-2, consistent weekly hours.

Email a short video of you accompanying (even just improvising over a
plie combination) to hiring@edmondballet.example.
